meta.title: Select
meta.lead: The native `<select>` is styled like the input for consistency.

blocks.label: Select example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Select example" class="component"><select aria-label=" Select your favorite cuisine..." name="favorite-cuisine" required=""><option disabled="" selected="" value="">Select your favorite cuisine...</option><option>Italian</option><option>Japanese</option><option>Indian</option><option>Thai</option><option>French</option></select></article>
blocks.code:
<select name="favorite-cuisine" aria-label="Select your favorite cuisine..." required>
  <option selected disabled value="">
    Select your favorite cuisine...
  </option>
  <option>Italian</option>
  <option>Japanese</option>
  <option>Indian</option>
  <option>Thai</option>
  <option>French</option>
</select>

blocks.label: Disabled and read-only example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled and read-only example" class="component"><select aria-label="Select your favorite snacks..." multiple="" size="6"><option disabled="">Select your favorite snacks...</option><option>Cheese</option><option selected="">Fruits</option><option selected="">Nuts</option><option>Chocolate</option><option>Crackers</option></select></article>
blocks.code:
<select aria-label="Select your favorite snacks..." multiple size="6">
  <option disabled>
    Select your favorite snacks...
  </option>
  <option>Cheese</option>
  <option selected>Fruits</option>
  <option selected>Nuts</option>
  <option>Chocolate</option>
  <option>Crackers</option>
</select>

blocks.label: Disabled example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled example" class="component"><select aria-label="Select a meal type..." disabled="" name="meal-type"><option>Select a meal type...</option></select></article>
blocks.code:
<select name="meal-type" aria-label="Select a meal type..." disabled>
  <option>Select a meal type...</option>
  <option>...</option>
</select>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><select aria-invalid="false" aria-label="Select your favorite pizza topping..." name="pizza-topping"><option disabled="">Select your favorite pizza topping...</option><option selected="">Pepperoni</option><option>Mushrooms</option><option>Onions</option><option>Green Peppers</option><option>Olives</option></select><small>Great choice!</small><select aria-invalid="true" aria-label="Select your favorite pizza topping..." name="pizza-topping" required=""><option disabled="" selected="" value="">Select your favorite pizza topping...</option><option>Pepperoni</option><option>Mushrooms</option><option>Onions</option><option>Green Peppers</option><option>Olives</option></select><small>Please select your favorite pizza topping!</small></article>
blocks.code:
<select aria-invalid="false">
  ...
</select>
<small>Great choice!</small>

<select required aria-invalid="true">
  ...
</select>
<small>
  Please select your favorite pizza topping!
</small>

blocks.md: The dropdown component allows you to build a custom select with the same style as the native select. See [Dropdown](https://picocss.com/docs/dropdown).
